versions.changelog:
Initial release of the "print-3d-model" skill.

- Opens the 773 LABS custom 3D printing quote page when requested.
- Reuses the existing Brave browser and tabs whenever possible.
- Ensures the expected 773 LABS page is loaded and visible.
- Handles authentication securely: stops at login if required, never submits credentials.
- Does not interact with forms, payments, or account settings.
